summary.text: Andre Carroll is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 201 who has served since September 30, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before taking office he worked as a community outreach liaison for a state senator's office.

paragraphs.text: Andre Carroll was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and earned an associate degree from Pierce College in 2017.
His career experience includes working as a community outreach liaison for Senator Anthony Williams' office, and he is affiliated with the Brothahood Foundation.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Carroll said he grew up in the Germantown section of Philadelphia and was raised by his grandmother.

In the same survey he described himself as a criminal justice reform activist and said he would work to ensure that education funding goes through the fair funding formula and that everyone has access to housing.
